styles.name: Jumper
styles.journal: Leaps clear of the water to shake the hook.

styles.name: Head-shaker
styles.journal: Shakes its head hard; a weak hookset comes loose.

styles.name: Long runner
styles.journal: Runs long and strong; a light line won't hold it.

styles.name: Bottom-hugger
styles.journal: Likes to hug the bottom, and dives for the weed.

styles.name: Roller
styles.journal: Rolls and twists the line round itself.
